description: You have everything that you need in this season , use your tools 🥂 #responsibility #preperation #selflove
transcript: We don't typically need more information. We need to learn how to use the resources and the tools that we currently have. There are natural tools that are innate that we don't know how to use and we go searching for more information or we go searching for others' recipes rather than looking at ourselves and understanding that we have everything that we need to get to the other side.
